content: Confronting people with toxicity usually escalates conflicts and harms relationships. Instead, try expressing your feelings constructively: "I feel frustrated when this happens. Can we address it together?" This encourages resolution without negativity. Let me know if you'd like help phrasing something assertively but respectfully!
